newsitem.title: POLAND: WestLB to double capital in Polish unit.
newsitem.headline: WestLB to double capital in Polish unit.

text.p: Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale will double the share capital of its Polish unit to more than 186 million zlotys in the second half of this year, Westdeutsche Landesbank Polska SA said on Thursday.
"Larger own capital will allow (West LB Polska) to step up operations on the money market as well as increase credit action," it said in a statement.
The Polish bank had a net loss of 8.4 million zlotys in 1996 and assets worth 116 million, the statement said.
West LB Polska plans to increase assets to 500 million zlotys at the end of 1997 from about 300 million at the end of June.
It also plans to double its credits to 200 million zlotys in the second half of the year and increase guarantees to 100 million from about 70 million at present.
